cases.about: An hour-old backup lists and gives back a readable file: OK, with its name, size, age and the line read back.

shell.output:
nightly-2026-10-27.tar.gz
nightly-2026-10-26.tar.gz
newest: nightly-2026-10-27.tar.gz
52428800 bytes, modified 1761530400
now 1761534000
etc/
etc/hosts
127.0.0.1 localhost

call.command: cd "$PANTHEON_PROJECTS"/'backups' && ls -t | head -5 && f=$(ls -t | head -1) && echo "newest: $f" && stat -c '%s bytes, modified %Y' "$f" && echo "now $(date +%s)" && case "$f" in *.zip) unzip -l "$f" | tail -3 && unzip -p "$f" "$(unzip -Z1 "$f" | grep -v '/$' | head -1)" | head -5 ;; *.tar.gz|*.tgz) tar -tzf "$f" | head -5 && tar -xzOf "$f" "$(tar -tzf "$f" | grep -v '/$' | head -1)" | head -5 ;; esac

script.say:
**Verdict**
- OK

**Newest backup**
- nightly-2026-10-27.tar.gz — 50 MB — 1 hour old (line: 26 hours)

**Read back**
- etc/hosts — first line: "127.0.0.1 localhost"

## Report
- listed 2 backups; checked the newest; one file read back

## Carry forward
- nightly-2026-10-27.tar.gz 52428800 bytes 2026-10-27
